content.rendered:
Laser Cap Carrying Case Features:

  • Perfect fit for your 148 Pro, 272 Premier, and 272 MD Laser Caps.
  • Attached handle for easy carrying.
  • Three large holes provide for ventilation.
  • Includes a heavy duty metal clip, so you can attach your carrying case to a travel suitcase, backpack, or gym bag.

excerpt.rendered: The Kiierr laser cap carrying case is fantastic looking, durable and the perfect way to transport your laser cap in style. It’s made from extremely lightweight material that wicks away moisture and allows for easy cleaning. This case protects your Kiierr148Pro or 272Premier laser caps for easy travel so you don’t miss treatments.
